rule.name: AffixLengthMismatch
rule.message: This substring cuts a different number of characters than the prefix or suffix the code has just tested, so the result keeps a piece of the affix or loses a character of the value (path.startsWith("file://") then path.substring(6) keeps a slash; a quoted string cut with substring(1, s.length() - 2) loses its last character). The code runs and returns a value that is off by one. Cut exactly what was tested: path.substring("file://".length()), s.substring(1, s.length() - 1), or keep the affix in a constant that both the test and the cut use. Right code is not reported: an offset taken from the literal ("file://".length()), an offset equal to the tested length, and a prefix followed by another test of the same value, such as a separator check.
